LVRR.RESTART_SESSION_CONFIRM: Restart the session? Running VR apps close and the headset reconnects.
LVRR.RESTART_REQUIRED: Some changes apply after the session restarts.
LVRR.DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect the headset? Running VR apps close if it doesn't reconnect within five minutes.
LVRR.QUIT_CONFIRM: Stop LVRR? The headset disconnects and all VR apps close.
LVRR.OFFLINE: The LVRR server is not running.
LVRR.FOREIGN: Another WiVRn server is running. Quit it to use LVRR.

REASON.HEADSET_SLOW: The headset hasn't answered yet. It may still apply the new settings.
REASON.BUSY: The headset session didn't end. Quit LVRR on the headset and try again.

HOME.PAIRING: Pairing is on. Enter this PIN on the headset:
HOME.VIRTUAL_MONITORS_HOWTO: Up to three extra monitors that exist only in VR. They show up as screens and in your desktop's display settings.

LIBRARY.TITLE: Library
LIBRARY.EMPTY: No VR apps found. Installed Steam games with VR support appear here; add other games and apps with "Add apps".
LIBRARY.LIST_FAILED: Couldn't list the VR apps. Try Refresh.
LIBRARY.NO_MATCH: No VR app matches the search.
LIBRARY.ADD_HEADER: Not in the library, add games that have VR through a mod or other VR apps:
LIBRARY.ADD_MORE: Type in the search to find more.
LIBRARY.ADD_NO_MATCH: No app to add matches the search.

HEADSET.TITLE: Headset
HEADSET.NOT_CONNECTED: Connect a headset to change its settings.
HEADSET.PERMISSION_DENIED: The headset refused a permission. Allow it in the headset's app settings for LVRR, then turn that setting on again.
HEADSET.NO_INPUT_FORWARDING: The server doesn't accept forwarded devices. Turn on "Accept keyboard, mouse and gamepad from the headset" in PC > Server; it applies from the next session.
HEADSET.INPUT_FORWARDING_UNAVAILABLE: The server doesn't accept forwarded devices yet. Restart the session; if this stays, run the checks in PC > Diagnostics.
HEADSET.SIMULTANEOUS_HANDS_DESC: Paused while body tracking runs. OpenVR games run body tracking while a virtual body tracker is on.
HEADSET.HIGH_POWER_DESC: Keeps the headset CPU and GPU at high clocks during a stream instead of following the load. Smoother, but the battery drains faster and it runs hotter.
HEADSET.EXTENDED_CONFIG_DESC: Lets the sliders go past their safe limits. Values that are too high can stutter the stream or break the picture.
HEADSET.ADVANCED_NOTE: These can hurt the stream or battery. Change them only if you know what they do.
HEADSET.OFFLINE: The headset isn't connected. Changes apply when it connects.
HEADSET.CONNECT_ONCE: Connect the headset once to change its settings here.

PC.TITLE: PC
PC.LATENCY_STAGES: Latency of the slowest video stream, by stage:
PC.NO_STATS: Statistics appear while a headset streams.
PC.PERF_OVERLAY: Show the performance overlay in VR
PC.REVOKE_CONFIRM: Forget this headset? It needs a new PIN to connect again.
PC.PAIR_HOWTO: To pair another headset, run "lvrr pair" on the PC; this ends the current session.
PC.HID_FORWARDING: Accept keyboard, mouse and gamepad from the headset
PC.USB_AUTO_CONNECT: Connect the headset when it's plugged in (needs adb and USB debugging)
PC.STEAM_COMMAND_NONE: Steam games need no launch options.
PC.SERVER_APPLIES: Server settings other than USB connection apply from the next session.
PC.SERVER_CONFIG_UNREADABLE: The server couldn't read its config file and runs with its defaults. Fix or delete the file, then stop and start LVRR.
PC.CREDITS: LVRR is built from WiVRn, WayVR, xrizer-edge and Monado. Thanks to their developers.
PC.FIX_ADMIN: Some fixes ask for the admin password on the PC's screen.
PC.PAIR_PIN: Open LVRR on the new headset, pick this PC and enter this PIN:
PC.PAIR_CONFIRM: Pairing a new headset ends the current session and closes its apps. Continue?
PC.PAIR_HOWTO_DESKTOP: Shows a PIN to enter on the new headset.
